props.covers: Step 5 of the worked example: an empty apply_ops batch with a score view performs a no-document-change review of whether the intended cross-section centerline reads clearly.

text.insert: Before adding the final content and connections, the agent takes a focused pure look at the Score gate. An empty

requests a section close-up. No document change occurs: the result still pushes APPLIED, a fresh BOARD digest, an empty DELTA, the cumulative BOARD DIFF, the lint delta, and REQUESTS, plus the Score gate close-up, but it does not produce a fresh full-board render or ROUTES for untouched connections. The close-up and the current full-board view let the agent judge whether alignment is carrying a deliberate peer signal. In this frozen artifact, cli centers at y=186 while objdiff centers at y=148, so the cross-section centerline is not satisfied; a later document-changing batch needs complete updateObject geometry before the agent can claim alignment.
